name: leo-search
description: Research for Codex with Exa, TinyFish, Context7, Jina, GitHub and no local browser automation.

interface.longDescription: Routes current web research, technical documentation, dynamic page extraction, GitHub and media lookups through remote MCP or existing command-line tools. Ordinary search never opens Chrome or installs a local headless browser.
interface.defaultPrompt: Research this with current sources using Leo Search, without opening a browser.
